nodes.label: --update incremental re-extraction
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts changed/new files (saves tokens and time); code-only changes skip semantic extraction (Step 3B) entirely since AST alone suffices; build_merge preserves edge direction and only prunes genuinely deleted files' nodes, since replace-on-re-extract already reconciles changed files.

nodes.label: --cluster-only reclustering
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters and regenerates GRAPH_REPORT.md/graph.json/graph.html from the existing graph without needing intermediate files that a prior build's cleanup already deleted.
